method: PubMed searched via NCBI E-utilities for papers with both the drug name and dengue (or DENV/flavivirus) in the title. Every abstract was then read and papers that were not a test of the drug against dengue were excluded. Findings are summarised from the abstract only; the full texts were not read.

excluded.28860870: about malaria treatment failure in a co-infected patient, not artemisinin against dengue
excluded.26709910: case report of a child on azathioprine who caught dengue; not a test of activity
excluded.27815736: about chloroquine-resistant malaria and nanoparticles, not chloroquine against dengue
excluded.27893666: a hepatitis C patient who caught dengue mid-treatment; not a dengue drug study
excluded.32326119: tested Zika, West Nile and tick-borne encephalitis; dengue was not among the viruses tested
excluded.28336346: tested West Nile and tick-borne flaviviruses; dengue was not tested
excluded.29642580: tested Zika, West Nile and tick-borne encephalitis; dengue was not tested
excluded.35460703: efficacy shown for Zika; dengue not separately demonstrated
excluded.39315833: a genome-sequence report from a trial, with no drug result
excluded.35015758: an Expression of Concern notice, not a study
excluded.30452439: the mosquito study that the 2022 Expression of Concern was issued against
excluded.33124646: an editorial comment with no original data
excluded.6615730: a 1983 lymphocyte-response letter, not a test of antiviral activity
excluded.23114081: a trial protocol published before any results
excluded.33083561: a trial protocol published before any results
excluded.39194045: a review of nanoengineered formulations, not an original test
excluded.40881003: a single-author clinical opinion piece proposing a protocol
excluded.20307577: a replicon methods paper; ribavirin appears only as an assay control
excluded.12543691: tested Modoc virus encephalitis, not dengue
excluded.23413698: tested virus levels in mosquitoes, not treatment of infection
excluded.41246530: no abstract available to verify the finding
excluded.39948816: no abstract available to verify the finding
excluded.21530348: no abstract available to verify the finding
excluded.40708402: a safety comparison for fever management, not a test of antiviral activity
excluded.36133864: tests a quantum-dot conjugate delivery platform rather than the drug as given to patients
excluded.41308480: tests a graphene-oxide hybrid material rather than the drug as given to patients

amantadine.title: Treatment Effectiveness of Amantadine Against Dengue Virus Infection.
amantadine.note: Uncontrolled 34-patient case series from one clinic; authors call for a proper trial.

amantadine.title: Inhibition of dengue virus replication by amantadine hydrochloride.
amantadine.note: Cut titres of all four dengue serotypes >90% in cell culture.

artemisinin.title: Artemisinin inhibits the replication of flaviviruses by promoting the type I interferon production.
artemisinin.note: Suppressed DENV, Zika and JEV by boosting host interferon response.

atorvastatin.title: An ivermectin - atorvastatin combination impairs nuclear transport inhibiting dengue infection in vitro and in vivo.
atorvastatin.note: With ivermectin, blocked nuclear transport of NS3/NS5 and cut infection in cells and mice.

atorvastatin.title: Effects of dengue virus type-2 serotype (DENV-2) on the expression profile of matrix metalloproteinases in THP-1, monocyte cells and their roles in endothelial dysfunctions: protective effect of atorvastatin.
atorvastatin.note: Reversed dengue-induced MMP expression in monocytes.

atorvastatin.title: Atorvastatin attenuates NS1 (Non-structural protein-1) of dengue type-2 serotype-induced expressions of matrix metalloproteinases in HL-60 cells, differentiated to neutrophils: Implications for the immunopathogenesis of dengue viral disease.
atorvastatin.note: Reduced NS1-driven matrix metalloproteinase release; a host effect, not direct antiviral.

atovaquone.title: The Antimalarial Compound Atovaquone Inhibits Zika and Dengue Virus Infection by Blocking E Protein-Mediated Membrane Fusion.
atovaquone.note: Blocked envelope-protein membrane fusion for Zika and dengue.

balapiravir.title: A randomized, double-blind placebo controlled trial of balapiravir, a polymerase inhibitor, in adult dengue patients.
balapiravir.note: Randomized placebo-controlled trial: no change in viraemia, NS1 or fever clearance. Authors state it does not support balapiravir.

balapiravir.title: Activation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells by dengue virus infection depotentiates balapiravir.
balapiravir.note: Explains the trial failure: potency dropped 125-fold in infected blood cells.

celecoxib.title: Exploring the in vitro potential of celecoxib derivative AR-12 as an effective antiviral compound against four dengue virus serotypes.
celecoxib.note: Tests AR-12, a celecoxib derivative, not celecoxib itself.

chloroquine.title: Chloroquine use improves dengue-related symptoms.
chloroquine.note: Randomized trial: no change in illness duration or fever; patients reported less pain.

chloroquine.title: A randomized controlled trial of chloroquine for the treatment of dengue in Vietnamese adults.
chloroquine.note: Randomized trial in 307 adults: no reduction in viraemia or NS1, and more vomiting.

chloroquine.title: Antiviral activity of chloroquine against dengue virus type 2 replication in Aotus monkeys.
chloroquine.note: Antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Aotus monkeys.

chloroquine.title: Chloroquine interferes with dengue-2 virus replication in U937 cells.
chloroquine.note: Reduced DENV-2 production in U937 cells.

chloroquine.title: Chloroquine inhibits dengue virus type 2 replication in Vero cells but not in C6/36 cells.
chloroquine.note: Inhibited DENV-2 in Vero cells but not in mosquito C6/36 cells.

cyclosporine.title: Cyclosporine inhibits flavivirus replication through blocking the interaction between host cyclophilins and viral NS5 protein.
cyclosporine.note: Blocked the cyclophilin-NS5 interaction flaviviruses depend on.

darunavir.title: Darunavir inhibits dengue virus replication by targeting the hydrophobic pocket of the envelope protein.
darunavir.note: EC50 below 1 uM against three DENV serotypes; blocks envelope attachment.

doxycycline.title: Effect of doxycycline and doxycycline with carica papaya on thrombocytopenia and leucopenia in acute dengue fever patients.
doxycycline.note: Small case-control study; better platelet and leukocyte recovery.

doxycycline.title: Dengue Patients Treated with Doxycycline Showed Lower Mortality Associated to a Reduction in IL-6 and TNF Levels.
doxycycline.note: Randomized: 46% lower mortality (11.2% vs 20.9%, p=0.05) with lower TNF and IL-6.

doxycycline.title: Modulation of cytokine and cytokine receptor/antagonist by treatment with doxycycline and tetracycline in patients with dengue fever.
doxycycline.note: Lowered IL-6, IL-1B and TNF in dengue patients versus supportive care.

doxycycline.title: Inhibitory effect of doxycycline against dengue virus replication in vitro.
doxycycline.note: Inhibited the DENV2 NS2B-NS3 protease (IC50 52 uM) and cut virus titre.

erlotinib.title: Feasibility and biological rationale of repurposing sunitinib and erlotinib for dengue treatment.
erlotinib.note: Sunitinib/erlotinib combination suppressed infection in DENV-infected mice.

galidesivir.title: Galidesivir Triphosphate Promotes Stalling of Dengue-2 Virus Polymerase Immediately Prior to Incorporation.
galidesivir.note: Its triphosphate stalls the dengue-2 polymerase directly.

hydroxychloroquine.title: Hydroxychloroquine-inhibited dengue virus is associated with host defense machinery.
hydroxychloroquine.note: Inhibited DENV 1-4 in vitro via host interferon signalling.

ivermectin.title: In-host modeling of dengue virus and non-structural protein 1 and the effects of ivermectin in patients with acute dengue fever.
ivermectin.note: Modelling of two trials: no effect on viraemia, but NS1 reduced.

ivermectin.title: Ivermectin Accelerates Circulating Nonstructural Protein 1 (NS1) Clearance in Adult Dengue Patients: A Combined Phase 2/3 Randomized Double-blinded Placebo Controlled Trial.
ivermectin.note: Phase 2/3 randomized: faster NS1 clearance, but no clinical efficacy at this dose.

ivermectin.title: Dengue virus NS1 secretion is regulated via importin-subunit β1 controlling expression of the chaperone GRp78 and targeted by the clinical drug ivermectin.
ivermectin.note: Blocks nuclear transport needed for NS1 folding and secretion.

ivermectin.title: Nuclear localization of dengue virus (DENV) 1-4 non-structural protein 5; protection against all 4 DENV serotypes by the inhibitor Ivermectin.
ivermectin.note: Inhibited NS5 nuclear import and protected against all four serotypes.

ivermectin.title: Ivermectin is a potent inhibitor of flavivirus replication specifically targeting NS3 helicase activity: new prospects for an old drug.
ivermectin.note: Targets NS3 helicase activity in flaviviruses.

ivermectin.title: Ivermectin is a specific inhibitor of importin α/β-mediated nuclear import able to inhibit replication of HIV-1 and dengue virus.
ivermectin.note: Importin alpha/beta inhibitor; blocks dengue replication.

leflunomide.title: Immunosuppressive effects and mechanisms of leflunomide in dengue virus infection of human dendritic cells.

lovastatin.title: Lovastatin for the Treatment of Adult Patients With Dengue: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
lovastatin.note: Randomized trial in 300 adults: safe, but no benefit on any clinical measure or on viraemia.

lovastatin.title: Lovastatin delays infection and increases survival rates in AG129 mice infected with dengue virus serotype 2.
lovastatin.note: Improved survival and lowered viraemia in DENV-2 infected mice.

metformin.title: Safety and tolerability of metformin in overweight and obese patients with dengue: An open-label clinical trial (MeDO).
metformin.note: Open-label trial: poorly tolerated, no clinical or virological benefit; authors advise against phase 3.

metformin.title: Metformin Use and Severe Dengue in Diabetic Adults.
metformin.note: Retrospective cohort of diabetic patients; less severe dengue by one WHO definition, not the other.

metformin.title: Antiviral effect of metformin and phenformin analogs against dengue in Huh-7 cells and AG129 mice.
metformin.note: Metformin and phenformin analogs reduced infection in cells and mice.

metformin.title: In vitro and in vivo efficacy of Metformin against dengue.
metformin.note: Weak activity (mM range); in mice a high dose worsened mortality and viraemia.

metformin.title: Cytoplasmic retention of dengue virus capsid protein by metformin impairing nuclear transport.
metformin.note: Retains dengue capsid protein in the cytoplasm by impairing nuclear transport.

metformin.title: The antiviral effect of metformin on zika and dengue virus infection.
metformin.note: Broad in vitro effect across flaviviruses, strongest in Huh-7 cells.

minocycline.title: Minocycline suppresses dengue virus replication by down-regulation of macrophage migration inhibitory factor-induced autophagy.
minocycline.note: Suppresses replication by down-regulating MIF-induced autophagy.

minocycline.title: Drug repurposing of minocycline against dengue virus infection.
minocycline.note: Reduced RNA synthesis and infectious virions across all four serotypes.

mycophenolate_mofetil.title: Mycophenolic acid (MPA) modulates host cellular autophagy progression in sub genomic dengue virus-2 replicon cells.
mycophenolate_mofetil.note: Acts through host autophagy in a DENV-2 replicon line.

mycophenolate_mofetil.title: Inhibition of dengue virus replication by mycophenolic acid and ribavirin.
mycophenolate_mofetil.note: Mycophenolic acid IC50 0.4 uM against DEN2 (ribavirin 50.9 uM).

mycophenolate_mofetil.title: Mycophenolic acid inhibits dengue virus infection by preventing replication of viral RNA.
mycophenolate_mofetil.note: Mycophenolic acid cut infected cells by 99% and secreted virus up to a millionfold.

niclosamide.title: The antiparasitic drug niclosamide inhibits dengue virus infection by interfering with endosomal acidification independent of mTOR.
niclosamide.note: Inhibited DENV-2 in vitro and in vivo via endosomal acidification.

niclosamide.title: Neutralization of Acidic Intracellular Vesicles by Niclosamide Inhibits Multiple Steps of the Dengue Virus Life Cycle In Vitro.
niclosamide.note: Neutralises acidic vesicles, hitting several steps of the dengue life cycle.

oseltamivir.title: Effect of oseltamivir phosphate versus placebo on platelet recovery and plasma leakage in adults with dengue and thrombocytopenia; a phase 2, multicenter, double-blind, randomized trial.
oseltamivir.note: Phase 2 randomized trial: no effect on platelet recovery or plasma leakage.

paritaprevir.title: Paritaprevir as a pan-antiviral against different flaviviruses.
paritaprevir.note: Docking-led screen against flavivirus proteases; computational with follow-up assays.

pentoxifylline.title: Use of pentoxifylline in treatment of children with dengue hemorrhagic fever.
pentoxifylline.note: Uncontrolled pilot in 55 children with dengue haemorrhagic fever.

prednisolone.title: Repeated dengue shock syndrome and 'dengue myocarditis' responding dramatically to a single dose of methyl prednisolone.
prednisolone.note: Single case of dengue shock responding to methylprednisolone; authors call for a trial.

prednisolone.journal: Southeast Asian J Trop Med Public Health
prednisolone.title: Hemodynamic response to high-dose methyl prednisolone and mannitol in severe dengue-shock patients unresponsive to fluid replacement.
prednisolone.note: Nine children with dengue shock unresponsive to fluids; 7 improved after high-dose steroid and mannitol.

prochlorperazine.title: Repurposing of prochlorperazine for use against dengue virus infection.
prochlorperazine.note: Blocks dengue binding and entry; protected or delayed lethality in mice.

remdesivir.title: Oral lipid prodrug V2043 (1-O-octadecyl-2-O-benzyl-sn-glyceryl-P-remdesivir nucleoside) protects mice from lethal dengue infection.
remdesivir.note: Oral remdesivir prodrug V2043 protected mice from lethal dengue.

remdesivir.title: Remdesivir triphosphate can efficiently inhibit the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase from various flaviviruses.
remdesivir.note: Remdesivir triphosphate inhibits the dengue RNA polymerase.

ribavirin.title: Combination of α-glucosidase inhibitor and ribavirin for the treatment of dengue virus infection in vitro and in vivo.
ribavirin.note: Combined with an alpha-glucosidase inhibitor in cells and animals.

ribavirin.title: Prophylactic ribavirin treatment of dengue type 1 infection in rhesus monkeys.
ribavirin.note: Placebo-controlled monkey study: ineffective as prophylaxis, no viraemia difference.

ribavirin.title: Treatment of intracranial dengue virus infections in mice with a lipophilic derivative of ribavirin.
ribavirin.note: Plain ribavirin did not improve survival in mice; a lipophilic analog did.

ribavirin.title: Antiviral Effects of Clinically-Relevant Interferon-α and Ribavirin Regimens against Dengue Virus in the Hollow Fiber Infection Model (HFIM).
ribavirin.note: Ribavirin alone worked only at toxic concentrations; the benefit came from interferon.

ribavirin.title: Inhibition of dengue virus production and cytokine/chemokine expression by ribavirin and compound A.
ribavirin.note: Cut DENV2 production and cytokine expression in A549 cells.

ribavirin.title: Inhibition of dengue virus replication by mycophenolic acid and ribavirin.
ribavirin.note: Inhibited DEN2 but at IC50 50.9 uM, over 100-fold weaker than mycophenolic acid.

ribavirin.title: The predominant mechanism by which ribavirin exerts its antiviral activity in vitro against flaviviruses and paramyxoviruses is mediated by inhibition of IMP dehydrogenase.
ribavirin.note: Activity tracks GTP-pool depletion rather than direct polymerase blockade.

ribavirin.title: A structural basis for the inhibition of the NS5 dengue virus mRNA 2'-O-methyltransferase domain by ribavirin 5'-triphosphate.
ribavirin.note: Crystal structure showing ribavirin triphosphate inhibiting the NS5 methyltransferase.

ribavirin.title: Interferon, ribavirin, 6-azauridine and glycyrrhizin: antiviral compounds active against pathogenic flaviviruses.
ribavirin.note: Active against 11 pathogenic flaviviruses including dengue in Vero cells.

ribavirin.title: Antiviral effects if ribavirin and 6-mercapto-9-tetrahydro-2-furylpurine against dengue viruses in vitro.
ribavirin.note: Inhibited all four serotypes in LLC-MK2 cells but had no effect in human blood leukocytes.

rimantadine.title: Suppression of dengue virus replication in vitro by rimantadine hydrochloride.
rimantadine.note: Suppressed replication of all four dengue types in cell culture.

sofosbuvir.title: Sofosbuvir as treatment against dengue?
sofosbuvir.note: Docking plus in vitro work against the dengue polymerase catalytic motif.

sofosbuvir.title: Evaluation of Sofosbuvir (β-D-2'-deoxy-2'-α-fluoro-2'-β-C-methyluridine) as an inhibitor of Dengue virus replication<sup/>.
sofosbuvir.note: EC50 1.4-4.9 uM in cells; its triphosphate chain-terminates dengue NS5.

sunitinib.title: Synergism between the tyrosine kinase inhibitor sunitinib and Anti-TNF antibody protects against lethal dengue infection.
sunitinib.note: With anti-TNF antibody, protected mice from lethal dengue.

sunitinib.title: Feasibility and biological rationale of repurposing sunitinib and erlotinib for dengue treatment.
sunitinib.note: Sunitinib/erlotinib combination suppressed systemic infection in mice.

suramin.title: Suramin inhibits helicase activity of NS3 protein of dengue virus in a fluorescence-based high throughput assay format.
suramin.note: Inhibits the dengue NS3 helicase in a high-throughput assay.
